environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No AWS WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. The application is exposed via a public DNS record pointing to the ALB. SQLite database is stored on local EBS volume.
